cost_accounting_authority.method: For each development-year control trade, derive the per-side cost rate from entry_cost/entry_notional; require equality to exit_cost/exit_notional and constancy across the development cohort before computing any counterfactual.

decision_time_price_authority.semantic_reason: Both fields are frozen causal feature outputs and algebraically reconstruct the current completed 4H close without future information.

replay_decision.reason: The first economic question is whether continuation after a preregistered context added or destroyed direct trade value. Capital-redeployment effects are a later mechanism and must not contaminate this first diagnostic.
